definitions.box: Fixed high/low of all five-minute bars [previous calendar 19:30, trading date 04:30).
definitions.qualifies: Both strict wick breaks in [04:30,08:30), including the08:25–08:30 candle. A touch does not qualify.
definitions.signal: The candle that first breaks the remaining side. Its open timestamp labels the time bucket. The condition becomes known at that candle close, five minutes later.
definitions.outcome: Only bars from signal confirmation through09:25, plus09:30 opening price. Trigger-candle extrema are excluded from future outcomes; extrema of09:30–09:35 are never used.
definitions.multiple: Up target=L+m×W; down target=H−m×W; W=H−L.120%=20% of box width beyond the corresponding boundary, not120% beyond it and not statistical SD.
definitions.primary: Second-break direction. Pending-target frequency excludes dates where that target was already touched by confirmation. After-confirmation touch frequency has all qualifying complete outcomes as denominator.
definitions.added: Additional extreme beyond the entire known04:30-to-confirmation extreme on the second-break side, divided byW. Zero is retained.
definitions.coverage: Separate qualification and outcome coverage. Same-bar dual breaks count in incidence but are excluded from directional estimates.
definitions.interpretation: Exploratory historical conditional frequencies. As-of filter uses only dates strictly before selected forecast date.95% Wilson intervals are descriptive and unadjusted for serial dependence/multiple filters; all years have been explored. No trading profitability claim.
